item.title: In the wake of closure, a digital archive of animated materials appears online
item.description:
📝 Share this Article:The stop motion work of Phil Tippett and the now closed Tippett Studios is being preserved in a free-to-browse online archive. August brought with it the sad news that Tippett Studios, the Berkeley-based animation and effects house founded by Phil Tippett, was closing down.
